strongest_angle: Google's Gemini 4 Argon and OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol compete across benchmarks, with Gemini 4 Argon leading on 18 of 28 shared benchmarks and solving all 12 end-to-end simulated cyberattack scenarios according to Google's October 2026 safety report.

key_facts.fact: Gemini 4 Argon leads on 18 of 28 shared benchmarks compared to OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol according to Vals AI comparison data.
The largest observed score gap between Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-6.1 Sol is 38.57 points on CyberBench v1.1, where Gemini 4 Argon leads.
Google's Gemini 4 Argon model solved all 12 of the end-to-end simulated cyberattack scenarios in safety evaluations published in October 2026.
Gemini 4 Argon with ADK React achieved a 77.2% overall score at rank 1 on the Wiz cyber model arena leaderboard.
